Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause excludes implied warranties but cannot override an express misrepresentation regarding the specific identity of the goods.

Q5672.reason: If the acquittal was based on self-defense, no crime occurred at all, which legally bars any subsequent prosecution for that same act under double jeopardy principles.

Q8537.reason: The definition of punishment must remain value-neutral to allow independent debate on whether the practice is morally justified without circular reasoning.
